viewing_check: Check species (smell, resinous, pale yellow close-grained is Huon; celery top or kingbilly look similar), width and length with a tape, thickness, any birdseye or figure, and splits or rot at the ends. Wide, thick, clean slab is worth more than $90.
rate_note: All AUD, no conversion. Gowans prices are hammer, premium about 19.8% extra.
